facts.note: Thirty-seven blocks west to east: the archive, the hall and the counting room in one row, and grass either side.
Twenty-five blocks north to south: the strongroom behind the hall's north wall, the hall, and grass round both.
Nine blocks across the hall inside its walls: the strongroom door in the middle of the north wall with a lock either side of it, far enough apart that two people can each stand at one.
Seven blocks across each wing inside its walls, west to east: the archive and the counting room are the same size, one either side of the hall.
